changes: Claude Code chat sessions now persist across reboot and sign-in again after your session expires, instead of clearing the session list.
Offline voice dictation no longer waits indefinitely when its on-device speech model cannot finish loading — the turn now stops after a bounded wait instead of leaving Omi stuck
Fixed custom API keys being cleared without explanation and stopped unvalidated or rotated keys from being used before enrollment
On-device transcription now closes on a pause in a noisy room instead of waiting out its 10-second window, so spoken commands reach Omi sooner
